dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL NOS), in a left axillary lymph node (excisional biopsy 2026-08-25), with multifocal splenic involvement. Non-germinal-center B-cell (Hans) phenotype: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive.

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: No genomic profile (for example TP53, MYD88, CD79B, EZH2) is in the record. It would not change the first-line choice but would inform trial eligibility.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: Carcinoma is excluded (AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative in lesional cells, no epithelial morphology), so this is not a recurrence of her 2016 ER-positive breast cancer.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III, B (stage IIIB), with the spleen recorded as S (nodal organ).

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: with the spleen recorded as S (nodal organ)... Bone marrow negative (biopsy 2026-09-08); liver, lungs, bone, adrenals and kidneys negative on PET-CT

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: fever to 38.4 C and drenching night sweats for more than 1 month.

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Bulk: mesenteric conglomerate 7.5 x 5.1 cm, bulky at the NCCN 7.5 cm threshold but not at the Lugano 10 cm threshold.

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the multifocal splenic nodules are scored as extranodal rather than nodal, the stage becomes IVB. That changes the staging label only; the first-line plan is the same.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by immunohistochemistry (MYC approx 45%, BCL2 approx 70%) but not double-hit: break-apart FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangement

mn_da_epoch.quote: R-CHOP, pola-R-CHP, DA-EPOCH-R and mini-R-CHOP all contain doxorubicin.

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (low-intermediate): age 59 (0), Ann Arbor stage III (1), LDH above ULN (1), ECOG 1 (0), extranodal sites 0 (splenic disease scored as nodal).

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI is about 2 (stage III 1, LDH elevated 1, age 59 0, ECOG 1 0, kidney/adrenal not involved 0, extranodal sites 0)

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Intermediate; CNS-directed prophylaxis is not indicated. CNS-IPI is about 2

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis, and no routine brain MRI or lumbar puncture without neurologic symptoms.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Six cycles would take her cumulative anthracycline from 240 mg/m2 to about 540 mg/m2 ... in a patient whose LVEF has fallen 17 points to 45% with GLS -14%, who had left chest and axillary radiation

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: I would not re-add doxorubicin even if LVEF recovers to 50% or more, because the cumulative limit would still be exceeded.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Start after the cardio-oncology optimization described below, targeting cycle 1 within about 2 weeks of tumor board

tx_cardioprotection.quote: start guideline-directed therapy now, before cycle 1, in agreement with cardiology. Start an ACE inhibitor or ARB (or sacubitril-valsartan) and an evidence-based beta-blocker (carvedilol or metoprolol succinate)

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Anthracycline-free immunochemotherapy: R-CEOP every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: R-CEOP has less randomized support than R-CHOP or pola-R-CHP, and I accept that trade-off.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Cardiac reassessment: echocardiogram with GLS after cycle 3, at end of treatment, and about 3 months after guideline-directed therapy starts.

mn_non_curative.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy: ECOG 1, NYHA class I

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT after cycle 6, scored by Lugano 2014: Deauville 1-3 without new lesions is complete metabolic response; Deauville 4-5 with reduced uptake from baseline is partial response and needs review.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis: intermediate risk (bulk 7.5 cm, LDH 2.3 x ULN, Ki-67 80%); start allopurinol 300 mg daily 2-3 days before cycle 1 (or febuxostat)

sup_gcsf.quote: Growth factor: primary pegfilgrastim (or on-body injector) on day 4 of each cycle; her febrile neutropenia risk is intermediate and the cardiac comorbidity and age near 60 justify primary prophylaxis.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue it to the planned completion in November 2026, pending agreement from breast medical oncology; it has no meaningful interaction with R-CEOP, and it does not treat or cause this lymphoma.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs are all nonreactive, so she is HBV-susceptible; no antiviral prophylaxis is needed for rituximab, but offer non-live hepatitis B vaccination.

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy: ECOG 1, NYHA class I, working full-time, independent in all activities, with a supportive husband who drives her to visits.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: 12-lead ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, and the result of any ischemia evaluation; no cardio-oncology or cardiology assessment is in the record.
